interpretations: Permanent binding: "постоянно" means surviving firewall-cmd --reload and reboot → --permanent with --zone=internal --add-interface=ens18, option A.
Immediate/session binding: if survival were not required, B would fit, but it is runtime-only and excluded by the word "постоянно".
Zone-creation or alternative-key reading: C (--new-zone does not take --interface) and D (--set-interface does not exist) are invalid syntax, so A remains the only valid option.
reason: The qualifier "постоянно" excludes runtime-only B; C and D are invalid syntax; --change-interface, which would also work, is not among the options. Exactly one option is defensible.
